review_scope: Manual current-source review and inspection of retained fixture evidence. Does not certify all datasets, final aggregate report, or non-auxiliary example coverage.

source_findings.expression_serialization: All Expr variants have explicit tags and structural fields. Retained Expr objects prevent address-reuse memo errors. Object addresses and Expr.hash are not digest inputs; child SHA-256 values remove DAG allocation/sharing/index dependence.
source_findings.interfaces: Theorem payload is kind, structured Name, ordered level parameters, and type; its dependency set is constants of type. Other kinds serialize every field of the pinned ConstantInfo variants, including values, safety, hints, inductive/constructor/recursor metadata. Dependency closure uses sorted names and dependency-first SCC condensation.
source_findings.canonical_names: Every stored occurrence retains its own IF input. Duplicate printed Name collisions are rejected. Repeated-name dependency bindings are resolved against actual imported env.find? records; production missing dependencies are rejected.
source_findings.optimistic_keys: K includes full declaration payload including theorem proof, dependency IFs, and pinned toolchain. Kernel group K hashes sorted member Name/constant-K pairs. This is an incomplete optimistic key, never used to accept a declaration.
source_findings.kernel_replay: A fresh kernel environment is filled in module import order and declaration dependency order. addDecl is called for safe definitions, unsafe/partial mutual groups, opaque constants, axioms, theorems, inductive groups, and quotient initialization. Generated constructor/recursor metadata must match kernel-generated values. Existing duplicate theorem bodies are checked under a fresh name.
source_findings.coverage_and_join: Every stored constant must map to a measured group. Group CPU is charged once to a representative. Retained raw calls, joined rows, module totals, coverage counts, group K values, repeated-key statistics, and CPU conservation are cross-checked by audit.py.
source_findings.cpu_accounting: Native CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID surrounds each addDecl invocation. Total process CPU includes startup; replay-main and startup CPU are separate. Summed kernel CPU is bounded by replay-main CPU and total process CPU; overhead is total minus summed kernel CPU.
source_findings.build_accounting: Measured builds use the requested memcap/Lake targets. A shared four-slot shim accepts unsupported Lake -j4 and passes -j4 to Lean; later builds set B2C_MAX_ACTIVE=1. Module elapsed excludes semaphore waiting. Whole-process-tree build CPU is tree_cpu_seconds; module CPU and wall elapsed remain separate.
source_findings.aggregation: Primary denominators use actually rebuilt FV modules in C2 through C20; C1 is excluded. Full-cone revisits are separately labeled. Local source/config invalidations and observed IF changes prevent cutoff credit. Reuse excludes inductive/quotient groups and requires a preceding group K. Avoidance mechanisms overlap and are not added.
source_findings.recovery: The interrupted C17 partial replay and its CPU are archived and excluded; the successful dataset contains a fresh full replay. Its original measured build digest is unchanged; resume artifact checks are separately excluded.

fixture_review_limit: Retained results and fixture source were inspected here; Lean fixture processes were not rerun during the active measured build.
known_missing_reuse_key_inputs: unit-like eta through constructor field counts
cutoff_limit: Own-constant/direct-import IF cutoff is a diagnostic counterfactual; nonconstant elaborator/environment state and transitive visibility require further modeling.
memory_limit: Recorded fallback uses process-tree RSS polling, which can miss short-lived children; no claim of cgroup enforcement.
remaining_completion_gates: All twenty complete measured datasets and per-dataset audits
Final aggregate metrics independently recomputed from actual rebuilds
At least three genuine non-auxiliary declarations in every positive requested kind/top-20 bucket
Final research-only signed commit/push and default audit.py
